testcase.name: Scenario: Access a ribbon tab in tabs-only mode: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:44:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Access a ribbon tab in tabs-only mode ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes ✔ And the View ribbon displays its group titles ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control once ✔ Then the ribbon shows its tabs without the group strip ✔ When the user selects the View tab ✔ Then the View commands appear in a temporary panel below the tabs ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control ✔ Then the expanded View ribbon is restored ✔ When the user clicks in an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the expanded View ribbon remains visible ✔ When the user chooses Minimize to Panel Buttons from the ribbon display menu ✔ Then the ribbon displays compact group buttons ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control once ✔ Then the full ribbon is restored
